Table writes today 0 of 3 Inverter Deye / Sunsynk Table layout six programs (Time of Use) Slots a day up to 6, at least 30 min each Runs through midnight Yes (a ring) Demand (MDI) limit in the inverter No Tier now Advisory (slot tables) Highest the data source supports Closed loop Highest allowed Advisory (slot tables) The tier is changed in Site settings by the owner, never above what the data source supports. Hold and release Overrides take effect at the next solve and the next table write. Hold Release to native Pausing and resuming control is for an administrator. Overrides in force Clear one to let the plan run as solved again. A pause and a forced charge are cleared by an administrator. No override is in force: the plan runs as solved. The table to key in Deye / Sunsynk, six programs (Time of Use) Copy as text Print Mon 9 Nov Tue 10 Nov Wed 11 Nov The table to key in, Mon 9 Nov Program Time Power (W) SoC % Grid charge Gen charge Intent 1 05:30 0 95 No No Hold the battery at 95 % (no discharge) Mark as applied APPLIED LOG No table has been marked applied yet. Fallback What the inverter does on its own when no plan holds. If the plan expires, or no fresh plan arrives for 3.0 h, the inverter returns to its native settings and keeps at least 20 % state of charge. Native settings Version 1, captured 8 Nov 2026, 19:40 by demo seed (Photo) Devices and data Work mode Self use Backup state of charge 20 % Grid charging Not allowed Time slots None (one mode all day) Edge device The small computer on site that receives signed plans and reads the inverter back. No edge device: plans are delivered as daily slot tables. Without an edge device the read-back is inferred from the site's behaviour; the installer keys each day's table and marks it applied.
